$comment: Wave 0 agent guard. The hook reads agents/ownership.json. It enforces nothing for a human session (no AGENT_ROLE and a branch with no lane prefix); it refuses an agent session's out-of-lane edits, edits outside its worktree, and the GitHub tools that act outside a worktree. It is a convenience layer: the real boundary is the GitHub ruleset and deploy approval gate in docs/agent-workflow/github-protections.md.
